name: Flight controller
description: Estimation, flight control, failsafes, mission execution, logging. Verifies and signs MAVLink with the shared signing key.

name: Companion computer
description: WireGuard endpoint, MAVLink router with allowlist filter, onboard autonomy and payload control, video encoding. Holds the shared signing key; inside the C2 trust base.

name: EO payload
description: Electro-optical camera producing survey imagery and video.

name: GNSS and compass module
description: Civil GNSS position and heading source for the flight controller.

name: ESCs and motors
description: Propulsion actuators driven by the flight controller.

name: Air data-link radio
description: Air side of the IP data link. Untrusted transport: no security credit is taken for its link-layer features (A-05).

name: Ground data-link radio
description: Ground side of the IP data link. Untrusted transport (A-05).

name: Ground control station
description: Mission planning, C2, telemetry and video display. Holds the shared signing key; inside the C2 trust base.

name: Maintenance and support station
description: Builds, signs and loads software; provisions keys; receives post-flight offload. Holds the shared signing key; inside the C2 trust base.

name: Operator
description: Pilot-in-command and mission operator at the GCS. Trusted but fallible (A-08).

name: Maintainer
description: Performs builds, loading, key provisioning and offload at the MSS. Trusted but fallible (A-08).

name: GNSS signals
description: Civil GNSS signals in space (A-10).

name: Upstream software sources
description: Open-source projects, package repositories and toolchains the MSS builds from (PX4, Linux distribution, QGroundControl, libraries).

name: FC MAVLink signing key file
description: 40-byte file: 32-byte shared secret key plus 64-bit timestamp. Readable, writable or removable by anyone with access to the SD card.

name: FC flight logs
description: Flight logs; may reveal flight paths and mission areas.

name: FC firmware and parameters
description: Bootloader, PX4 firmware image and parameter set, including failsafe settings.

name: CC system image and configuration
description: Boot chain, root filesystem, applications, router allowlist and firewall configuration.

name: CC credentials
description: Copy of the shared MAVLink signing key, CC WireGuard private key, GCS WireGuard public key.

name: CC mission data
description: Survey imagery and the active mission plan.

name: GCS credentials
description: Copy of the shared MAVLink signing key, GCS WireGuard private key, CC WireGuard public key.

name: GCS mission data
description: Mission plans, telemetry logs and received imagery.

name: MSS key material
description: Master copy of the shared MAVLink signing key, WireGuard key pairs before provisioning, software signing keys (P2, P3).

name: MSS release artifacts
description: Built and signed images, SBOMs and build provenance (P4); offloaded logs and imagery.

name: C2 uplink
interface: UDP over CMP-RAD-G/CMP-RAD-A; WireGuard; MAVLink 2 signed
description: Commands, mission upload and parameter writes. Signed by the GCS end to end to the FC; encrypted GCS to CC.

name: Telemetry downlink
interface: UDP over CMP-RAD-A/CMP-RAD-G; WireGuard; MAVLink 2 signed
description: FC and CC telemetry, status and acknowledgements.

name: Video downlink
description: Payload video and imagery previews. Not covered by MAVLink signing; protected by WireGuard only.

name: CC to FC commands
description: GCS traffic forwarded after the allowlist filter, plus CC-originated autonomy and payload commands signed with the shared key.

name: FC to CC telemetry
description: FC telemetry for the GCS and for onboard autonomy.

name: Payload imagery
description: Raw imagery and video from the payload.

name: GNSS signals
description: Satellite navigation signals received over the air.

name: Navigation data
description: Position, velocity, time and heading.

name: Actuator commands
description: Motor and ESC commands.

name: Operator input
description: Mission plans, commands and manual control.

name: FC maintenance load
interface: USB; MAVLink 2 (signed once a key exists)
description: Firmware load, parameters and initial signing-key provisioning (SETUP_SIGNING) while disarmed.

name: CC maintenance load
description: System images, configuration and credentials (signing key, WireGuard keys).

name: GCS provisioning
description: GCS software, signing key and WireGuard keys.

name: CC data offload
description: Post-flight imagery and CC logs.

name: FC log offload
description: Post-flight ULogs.

name: Upstream software intake
description: Source code, packages, toolchains and third-party binaries.

name: Maintainer actions
description: Build, sign, load, provision and offload commands.

name: Air-ground RF link
description: Everything between the radios is observable and injectable by an RF-proximate adversary, including jamming.

name: Flight-critical / mission-computing boundary
description: Separates the RTOS flight controller from the general-purpose Linux companion computer. Baseline interface: MAVLink 2 over UART only (DD-03).

name: Air vehicle physical boundary
description: On-board storage and maintenance and debug interfaces are exposed if the vehicle is lost, captured or left unattended.

name: GCS host boundary
description: Separates the GCS host from its operator, the data link and maintenance media.

name: Supply-chain boundary
description: Separates externally controlled upstream sources from the MSS build and signing environment.

name: GNSS RF environment
description: Civil GNSS signals are unauthenticated and can be jammed or spoofed.
